findings.summary: The logo link's accessible name is "Homepage", which replaces the visible text "WaterLevels.org", so a speech command for the brand does not match.
findings.fix: Remove aria-label="Homepage", or change it to "WaterLevels.org homepage" so the name contains the visible brand. This logo is in the header on all 12 pages.

findings.summary: Each map popup link says "View station" and points at a different gauge. The station name is a sibling, outside the link's sentence, paragraph, list item, or table cell.
findings.fix: Make the visible link the station name, for example View ${name}. If the words stay "View station", put the name in the same anchor: View station ${name}.

findings.summary: Header links to the disclosures page say "Data", which does not say the destination is data disclosures. The footer names that same URL "Disclosures".
findings.fix: Use "Data disclosures" for the desktop link at line 18 and the mobile link at line 64. Use that same visible label for the footer "Disclosures" link so the repeated destination has one name.

findings.summary: The footer link "AUP" does not say it opens the Acceptable Use Policy. That page's heading and the terms link both use the full name.
findings.fix: Change the footer link text from "AUP" to "Acceptable Use Policy", matching app/views/pages/aup.html.erb and the terms link.

findings.summary: The shared footer link "Johnathan Lyman" opens a new tab and the link never says so. The footer renders on every in-scope page except the map.
findings.fix: <%= link_to "https://johnathan.org", rel: "noopener noreferrer", target: "_blank" do %>Johnathan Lyman (opens in new tab)<% end %>

findings.summary: Twenty-three disclosures links use target="_blank" and none warn that they open a new tab. That includes agency names, the author credit, and bare hostnames.
findings.fix: Add visible text "(opens in new tab)" inside each target="_blank" anchor on this page (lines 32 through 208) and keep rel="noopener noreferrer". A warning icon also needs an equivalent sr-only phrase.
findings.evidence: USGS Water Data APIs

findings.summary: Fourteen FAQ links use target="_blank" without a new-tab warning, including the author credit, water.noaa.gov, and the agency API names.
findings.fix: Add "(opens in new tab)" to each target="_blank" anchor in faq.html.erb at lines 127, 128, 155, 160, 164, 168, 173, 177, 179, 195, 233, 235, 387, and 429.

findings.summary: Author links on About, Privacy, and Terms open johnathan.org in a new tab and do not tell the user.
findings.fix: Add "(opens in new tab)" to the About link "Johnathan Lyman" and to the Privacy and Terms links "johnathan.org". Keep rel="noopener noreferrer" and target="_blank".

passed: No click here, read more, learn more, here, or more link text.
No bare URL fails 2.4.4. Each raw URL or path is in a sentence or paragraph that states where it goes.
Station cards, trend rows, popular waterway rows, search results, and the map station list are one link each and include the station or place name.
No adjacent image and text links share a destination.
Navigation uses links. Search, locate, map zoom, settings, FAQ categories, and form submit use buttons. No anchor lacks href.
No in-scope link points at a PDF, CSV, or other non-HTML file.
Repeated labels such as Manage email alerts, flood alerts list, Contact, About, FAQ, and NWPS API each go to one destination.
Skip link text is Skip to main content. Desktop and mobile primary nav are not exposed together.
